"""
Database interfaces and abstract base classes for decoupling plugins from database implementations.

This module defines contracts (interfaces) for database services used by plugins,
enabling loose coupling and improved testability.
"""

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple, Any, Optional
from motor.motor_asyncio import AsyncIOMotorDatabase


class IMediaRepository(ABC):
    """Interface for media/document filtering operations."""

    @abstractmethod
    async def find_filter(self, group_id: str, name: str) -> Tuple[Optional[str], Optional[str], Optional[str], Optional[str]]:
        """Find a filter by name in a group."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_filters(self, group_id: str) -> List[str]:
        """Get all filter names for a group."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def delete_filter(self, group_id: str, name: str) -> bool:
        """Delete a specific filter from a group."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def del_all_filters(self, group_id: str) -> bool:
        """Delete all filters from a group."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def count_filters(self, group_id: str) -> int:
        """Count filters in a group."""
        pass


class IUserChatRepository(ABC):
    """Interface for user and chat management operations."""

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_banned(self) -> Tuple[List[int], List[int]]:
        """Get lists of banned users and disabled chats."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_settings(self, chat_id: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get settings for a chat."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def update_settings(self, chat_id: int, settings: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        """Update settings for a chat."""
        pass


class IConnectionRepository(ABC):
    """Interface for connection management operations."""

    @abstractmethod
    async def active_connection(self, user_id: int) -> Optional[int]:
        """Get the active group connection for a user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def all_connections(self, user_id: int) -> Optional[List[int]]:
        """Get all group connections for a user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def if_active(self, user_id: int, group_id: int) -> bool:
        """Check if a group is active for a user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def make_active(self, user_id: int, group_id: int) -> bool:
        """Activate a group connection for a user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def make_inactive(self, user_id: int) -> bool:
        """Deactivate all group connections for a user."""
        pass
